description:
AI chatbot with cloud API, local GGUF models, and demo mode
AI chatbot for Android, iOS, and desktop with three backends:
- Cloud API (OpenAI-compatible: OpenAI, LM Studio, LocalAI, Ollama)
- Local GGUF models via llamadart - offline
- Demo mode (echo) without API key

Features: Vision, web search (DuckDuckGo), model library with downloads from Hugging Face, secure API key storage, named conversations, streaming, markdown, thinking mode, light/dark theme.
